findings.category: Observer must preserve the original exception/cancellation
findings.title: New native diagnostic cleanup can replace the primary cancellation and skip remaining FD cleanup
findings.evidence: The newly inserted finally directly calls cancel_dump_traceback_later(), os.close(startup_fault_fd), then os.close(startup_primary_fd), before the existing observer/evidence cleanup. None of those added operations is isolated from failure. An error in the first close escapes finally, replaces the original exception, and prevents closing the primary/evidence FDs. This is not a fabricated product cause: it is a reproduced QA instrumentation failure boundary.

reproduction.source_extraction: AST-extract only BOOTSTRAP, HOST_LAUNCH_DIAGNOSTIC, STARTUP_HOST_STOP, STARTUP_NATIVE_PRIMARY and batch2_installed_entry from the exact caller; no full caller/native module execution. Generate the startup bootstrap in a fresh private scratch directory. Execute its exact STARTUP_PRIMARY hook with only /state/ replaced by that owned directory. Execute the exact try/runpy/finally suffix with a synthetic runpy.run_module that raises a specific asyncio.CancelledError object; emit/phase callbacks are no-effect seams.
reproduction.negative_cut: Before executing the suffix, cancel the one-shot faulthandler and close the hook-owned startup_fault_fd. Its real os.close in the generated finally then raises EBADF. This is a deterministic close-failure seam, not evidence of an actual installed EBADF.
reproduction.cleanup: All still-open exact test-owned descriptors closed after observation; faulthandler cancelled. No live native/Host/PG/OCI resource created. OS process exit would ultimately close descriptors in a real failed bootstrap; the finding does not claim an indefinite cross-process FD leak.

findings.violated_requirement: The observer must not replace the primary exception/cancellation; diagnostic cleanup must close owned descriptors without making diagnostic loss a new product cause.
findings.remedy: Minimally isolate each newly added cancellation/close operation as best-effort diagnostic cleanup, continue subsequent exact FD closures, and preserve the active exception object. Mark unavailable diagnostic evidence UNKNOWN rather than letting its cleanup failure become the native cause. Add one focused positive plus this close-failure control on the actual generated tail; no new supervisor or generic fault matrix is needed.
